title: Out-of-range values clamp without an error
fact: The awg clamps or ignores an out-of-range value and leaves the error queue empty.
consequence: The error queue alone misses most failures.
where: every set_ returns the applied value; apply_ helpers compare and raise NotAppliedError
review: 2026-10-16: retested: FRQ 1e12 clamps to 200 MHz, no error (SCPI expects -222). original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: A bare modulation type write is ignored
fact: MDWV <TYPE> alone does nothing; MDWV <TYPE>,SRC,<src> works.
consequence: A type change seems to work but does not.
review: 2026-10-16: not reproduced: a bare MDWV FM switched the type. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: State change needs 200 ms
fact: A command within 200 ms after mod, sweep or burst STATE,ON is lost; *OPC? returns early.
consequence: Settings written right after on() do not apply.
review: 2026-10-16: not reproduced for modulation: a write right after STATE,ON applied. Sweep and burst not retested. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Arb upload needs VXI-11
fact: A raw socket cuts binary data at byte 0x0A.
consequence: Uploads over a raw socket corrupt or hang.
where: Arb.apply_upload raises on a SOCKET resource
review: 2026-10-16: not reproduced: a raw-socket upload with 0x0A bytes arrived complete (2000 B). original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: SEGMent:COUNt? gets no reply while a sequence runs
fact: With AWG:STATE RUN, SEGMent:COUNt? times out (no reply, C1 and C2); SEGMent1:LENGth? answers at once. Stopped, both answer.
consequence: A query hangs the link until timeout.
where: Sequence.get_segment_count raises UnsupportedError while running; get_settings reads segments only when stopped
review: 2026-10-16: first retest queried SEGMent1:LENGth? (answered) and withdrew the record by mistake; the full awg verification then hung on SEGMent:COUNt? while running (original repository measurements/2026-10-16_08-11-06_verify_sdg3000x.md), confirmed on C1 the same hour. Restored as a quirk with the corrected fact.

title: SCPI refuses segment insert, scale, wait events, start segment, step and advanced run modes
fact: These return -200 over SCPI, in every run mode including advanced (WAITEvent, STARTNumb, RMODe STEP/ADV, 2026-10-15 22:08). The sequence file sets them: awg-saved codes run_mode 0 CONT, 1 TCON, 3 BURS, 4 STEP, 5 ADV; wait_event 0 AUTO, 1 MAN, 3 EXT; trigger_edgeA 0 rise, 1 fall, 2 both. The SCPI edge header is TRIGAger:SLOPe (the PG spelling); TRIGger:SLOPe is undefined.
consequence: The full sequence feature set needs the file route.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: WAITEvent, STARTNumb, RMODe STEP/ADV, INSErt, SCALe all -200; the PG documents them. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: An out-of-range code in a sequence file crashes SCPI
fact: trigger_source code 2 (no source writes it; 0 FRUN, 1 MAN, 3 TIM, 4 EXT) loads without error; the next TRIGger:SOURce? kills the SCPI server until a power cycle. Segment wait_event codes 2 and 4 do the same on SEGMent:WAITEvent? (2026-10-15 22:1x, 22:2x); the front panel froze too. Valid wait_event codes: 0 AUTO, 1 MAN, 3 EXT; the TIMe code is unknown, so the driver offers no timer wait event.
consequence: One bad code needs the operator's hands.
where: Sequence file builder: writes only codes from awg-saved files (maps in the driver); checks every code before MMEMory:TRANsfer
evidence: original repository probes/probe_awgx_hang_2.py; docs/measurements_sdg3202x.md, Root cause of the awg SCPI hang; original repository measurements/2026-10-15_22-12-00_probe_awgx_wait.md
review: 2026-10-16: not retested (a crash needs a power cycle); reproduced three times on 2026-10-15.

title: No lock status
fact: No query reports 10 MHz input presence or lock; ROSC? echoes the source.
consequence: The driver cannot confirm the lock.
review: 2026-10-16: desk: no lock query exists in the PG; an absent feature, not a fault. The screen does show a clock message.

title: Analog input range and scale
fact: AM, DSB-SC, FM, PM, PWM: 10 kohm, +-6 V (DS 12 Vpp = 100 %). Measured: AM 16.4 %/V (100 % at 6.1 V); DSB-SC full carrier at 6.12 V; FM and PWM reach the set deviation at 6 V; PM reaches deviation/2 at 6 V (deviation/12 deg/V at 90 and 180 deg). Negative input is not clamped (-1.00 V measured). With source ch1/ch2 the other channel's waveform modulates and the modulation frequency setting is ignored.
consequence: Depth and deviation follow the input level; the driver cannot see the input.
evidence: records *_a2_ext_am_*, _fm_*, _pm_*, _pwm; DS modulation input table; records *_awg_ext_dsbsc_*, *_awg_ext_pm_scale_*, *_awg_am_source_ch2
review: 2026-10-16: desk: measured input scales; MODULATION IN unwired, not retested.

title: Keying input is TTL and diode clamped
fact: ASK, FSK, PSK: VIH 2 to 5.5 V, VIL -0.5 to 0.8 V, 100 kohm. A +-1 V square clamps at -0.82 V and does not key. No negative voltage while a keying mode is selected.
consequence: An external source can stress the input or fail to key; software cannot guard an external source.
where: Modulation.apply_external, apply_ask, apply_fsk, apply_psk docstrings; original repository benches/safety.toml limit
review: 2026-10-16: desk: datasheet input spec; MODULATION IN unwired, not retested.

title: PM glitch and 180 deg step at each zero crossing of the modulating signal
fact: Internal and external PM apply the deviation to the size of the modulating signal and add 180 deg while it is negative; at each zero crossing the carrier makes a burst of fast cycles.
consequence: PM is clean only for a modulating signal of one polarity.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: internal PM 90 deg: phase -191..210 deg with 4 steps > 120 deg in 2.4 ms. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: One channel holds Trig/Sync OUT; none during burst or sweep
fact: C2 sync on turns C1 sync off; sync on is refused (no error) while burst or sweep is on; the sync type ignores remote writes.
consequence: Sync seems on but is off.
evidence: original repository probes/probe_awg_section1.py, original repository probes/probe_awg_a1.py
review: 2026-10-16: retested: C2 sync on turns C1 sync off; sync on during burst refused with no error. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Burst count and hold limits
fact: COUNT applies only with an external or manual trigger (written COUNT, read back COUNTER); HOLD takes START and END only.
consequence: Other writes are ignored, no error.
review: 2026-10-16: desk: count needs an external or manual trigger (UM); COUNT/COUNTER naming only. Not retested.

title: Gated burst ends the current cycle
fact: After the gate closes the carrier completes its cycle.
consequence: Output runs up to one carrier period past the gate.
review: 2026-10-16: desk: completing the cycle is normal gated-burst behaviour. TRIG/SYNC IN unwired.

title: Start clamps to the old stop; sweep on moves the carrier
fact: START above the present STOP clamps to it; sweep on sets the carrier to the sweep center frequency.
consequence: Wrong start or carrier frequency, no error.
where: Sweep.apply_frequency (start, stop, start again), Sweep.apply_amplitude (center = carrier)
evidence: original repository probes/verify_awg_a1.py sweep_edge; original repository probes/verify_awg_a4.py amp_sweep
review: 2026-10-16: desk: start/stop clamp and centre carrier are design choices.

title: Trigger out marks the ramp start; holds follow the ramp
fact: The Trig/Sync OUT edge marks the start of the ramp; then end hold, return, start hold. SWWV? lists ENDTIME twice (hold end, return time).
consequence: Scope timing from the trigger excludes the start hold.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: SWWV? lists ENDTIME twice (malformed reply). The ramp-start marker is an observation. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Filter range and passband
fact: Cutoff below 10 MHz clamps to 10 MHz; the 20 MHz setting is -1.3 dB at 2 MHz and -3 dB at 19.8 MHz; the 50 MHz setting is flat to 15 MHz, -3 dB at 47.8 MHz.
consequence: No low cutoffs; passband loss at the 20 MHz setting.
review: 2026-10-16: desk: filter characterisation.

title: File read through WVDT loses an odd last byte
fact: WVDT? USER returns the file bytes; an odd-length file loses its last byte.
consequence: Read-back is exact only for even sizes.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: a 4097 B file reads back as 4096 B. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Copy and move report a false error
fact: MMEMory:COPY and MMEMory:MOVE act (the target appears) and queue -108 Parameter not allowed; WVDT? USER also queues -108.
consequence: Error-queue checks report a failure that did not happen.
where: Files.apply_copy, Files.apply_move, Files.get_file accept -108 and confirm by the listing
review: 2026-10-16: retested: MMEMory:COPY acts and queues -108. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Setup recall leaves the outputs off
fact: MMEMory:LOAD:XML restores the waveform settings; the output reads OFF afterwards although it was on at save.
consequence: A recalled setup produces no signal until the output turns on.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: recall restores the waveform, output reads off; output state on recall is a design choice. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: IQ user files are EasyIQ .arb files, format undocumented
fact: IQ:WAVEload:USERstored plays a .arb file made by the EasyIQ PC software; the programming guide gives no file format.
consequence: The driver cannot make an IQ user file; a guessed format may crash the awg (compare SDG-07).
where: IQ.apply_user checks the file exists and never writes one
review: 2026-10-16: desk: format undocumented; needs EasyIQ.

title: IQ levels ignore the output load setting
fact: In IQ mode both outputs are scaled for a 50 ohm load at any load setting: CH1 into 50 ohm reads 0.049 V rms per channel at -10 dBm for loads 50/50, hiz/hiz, 50/hiz; an unterminated output shows twice that.
consequence: Into high impedance the IQ level is 6 dB above the setting.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: IQ level identical for load 50 and hiz (0.0701 V rms both); the load setting is ignored silently. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Each setting write takes about 110 ms to execute
fact: BSWV AMP and MDWV DEPTH writes execute in 110 to 120 ms each, VXI-11 and socket alike; queued writes run no faster (socket, 200 queued amplitude writes: 72 s). Two channels per update: 4.1 to 4.4 updates/s.
consequence: SCPI cannot update two carriers at 20 to 100 updates/s; streaming control needs an analog path (MODULATION IN) or another source.
review: 2026-10-16: desk: write rate figure.

title: An uploaded arb is stretched to fill the amplitude
fact: Arb data spanning -0.81..0.81 with amplitude 1 Vpp and offset 0 played as -0.5..0.5 V (clipped at the scope edge, 2026-10-15 demo_cube): the awg maps the data extremes to the amplitude, not the code range -32767..32767.
consequence: Two channels with different data spans get different scales; small data does not give a small signal.
evidence: original repository records/2026-10-15_14-39-07_demo_cube; original repository probes/demo_cube.py
review: 2026-10-16: desk: arb data scaled to the amplitude is the usual arb behaviour.

title: *RST sets the clock source to internal; each switch flashes a clock message
fact: ROSC EXT read back external; after *RST it read internal (2026-10-15 21:50). The bench feeds rear 10MHz IN from scope AUX OUT. During awg.reset() the screen flashes 'No available external clock detected' (the moment on internal); the lock holds after: counter shift -0.444 ppm external vs internal, repeated (original repository measurements/*_probe_awg_clock_lock.md).
consequence: Each *RST drops the shared 10 MHz reference and flashes 'No available external clock detected' on the screen (not in the error queue, SDG-31).
where: SDG3000X.reset recalls Local/drv_default.xml (saved after one *RST) instead of *RST: every snapshot setting equals *RST, the clock source is untouched (MEAS 2026-10-15 22:51); System.set_clock_source docstring
evidence: session 2026-10-15 21:50, probe in chat; tests/test_sdg3000x.py reset clock test
review: 2026-10-16: retested: *RST sets ROSC INT, a defined default. The driver recalls a per-clock default setup. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Totalizer edge and gate settings sit under TOTalizer, not CONFig
fact: SENSe:COUNTer:CONFig:EDGE?, GATE:STATe?, GATE:MODE?, GATE:POLarity?, GATE:EDGE? and MEASure? give -113 Undefined header; SENSe:COUNTer:TOTalizer:EDGE?, GATE:STATe?, GATE:MODE?, GATE:POLarity? answer. TOTalizer:GATE:EDGE? gives -200 in LEVEL gate mode. MEASure sits under FREQuency. No pulse width query (FREQuency:PWIDth?, NWIDth? -113).
consequence: The PG table (p.74) leads to undefined headers; widths need duty x period.
where: Counter class docstring, Counter.set_gate, get_gate, measure_width_positive
review: 2026-10-16: retested: the PG headers CONFig:EDGE/GATE/MEASure give -113; TOTalizer:EDGE answers. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Counter PAUSe is inverted
fact: PAUSe? reads ON while the counter counts; after PAUSe OFF the statistics count stays fixed (2 -> 2 in 2 s); PAUSe ON again resumes.
consequence: A literal PAUSe ON resumes counting instead of holding it.
review: 2026-10-16: not retested (COUNTER IN unwired); measured twice on 2026-10-15.

title: Remote queries stall the counter
fact: Frequency mode, 1 kHz: 12 measurements in 20 s with no remote traffic; 0 in 20 s with 10 SNUMber queries/s (197 queries). 10 kHz and 100 kHz: 6 in 10 s without traffic.
consequence: A tight polling loop never gets a new measurement; readings stay stale.
where: Counter.wait_measurements (polls every 2 s), Counter class docstring
review: 2026-10-16: not retested (COUNTER IN unwired); measured on 2026-10-15.

title: SEGMent:WAVeform ignores user arb names
fact: After *RST, C1:AWG:SEGMent1:WAVeform user_sa (a stored user arb) leaves the segment on its old waveform with no error; built-in names (Square, Sine) apply. Before the fix, every segment read back the last uploaded arb.
consequence: A user arb segment set over SCPI plays the wrong waveform silently.
where: Sequence.apply (user arbs always through the sequence file, path /usr/bin/siglent/usr/usr/<name>.bin as the awg saves it); Sequence.set_segment read-back raises
review: 2026-10-16: retested: SEGMent1:WAVeform with a stored user arb leaves StairUp, no error. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Trig/Sync OUT gives no pulse in sequence mode
fact: C1:SYNC? gives -200 in sequence mode (running or stopped); C1:SYNC ON is accepted, yet the scope on EXT saw no trigger in 15 s with a 600 us sequence playing. The sequence file field trigger_out (awg-saved 3) controls the output; its other codes are unknown.
consequence: No awg sync for the scope in sequence mode.
where: Sequence class docstring; original repository probes/verify_awg_sequence.py triggers the scope on a pulse width of CH1
review: 2026-10-16: retested: C1:SYNC? gives no reply in sequence mode (query hangs); no pulse on the scope. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Screen dump returns an empty image
fact: SCDP answers in 3 to 4 s with a 54-byte BMP header (24 bpp, width 0, height 0) and no pixel data, over VXI-11 and the raw socket alike, every call. SCDP?, PRINt?, HCOPy:SDUMp:DATA? are undefined (-113).
consequence: No remote view of the awg screen; on-screen messages (for example the clock message) are invisible to software and do not reach the error queue.
review: 2026-10-16: retested: SCDP returns a 0x0 BMP; SCDP is not in the PG. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: Arb CSV files load only in the EasyWaveX layout
fact: A CSV with one value per line, or time,value rows without a header, is ignored on selection: the arb stays as it was, no error (Local and U-disk0). The EasyWaveX layout loads from Local and U-disk0: 'data length,N', 'frequency,F', 'amp,A', 'offset,O', 'phase,P', 7 empty lines, 'xpos,value', then 'time,value' rows, CR LF. A .dat with one value per line loads. On selection the awg converts the file to Local/<stem>.bin and sets the amplitude to the header amp (2 Vpp for .dat). MMEMory:TRANsfer writes to U-disk0 too. Shape correlation 0.997 to 1.000 on the scope.
consequence: A plain CSV selects nothing; the selection read-back is the only sign.
where: Arb.set_file (read-back raises NotAppliedError); Files.apply_write_csv writes the EasyWaveX layout
evidence: original repository measurements/*_probe_awg_usb_arbs.md, original repository measurements/*_probe_awg_local_csv.md, original repository measurements/*_verify_awg_arbfile_csv.md
review: 2026-10-16: desk: the awg loads the documented EasyWaveX layout; a plain CSV is not that format.

title: Scenario and sequence levels load but do not play
fact: A file with one scenario holding two sequences ([A] loop 2 -> [B] loop 3 -> back) loads; the awg re-saves both sequences unchanged; only sequence 0 plays (A repeated, period 400 us), in run mode continuous and advanced. The UM, PG and datasheet describe one segment table and no scenarios, jumps or markers: the file schema is shared with other models.
consequence: Scenarios, sequence-level loops and goto, jumps and markers are not features of this model.
where: Sequence class docstring; docs/coverage_awg.md (not on this model)
evidence: original repository measurements/*_probe_awgx_levels_seqs*/; original repository records/*_awgx_levels_seqs*
review: 2026-10-16: desk: scenarios are not a feature of this model (no manual describes them).

title: The amplitude limit is in high-impedance volts
fact: MAX_OUTPUT_AMP 0.6 Vpp with load 50: a 1 Vpp sine request reads back 0.3 Vpp, scope 0.295 Vpp into 50 ohm; no awg error.
consequence: With a 50 ohm load the largest amplitude is half the limit value.
where: Output.set_amplitude_limit docstring; apply_ helpers raise NotAppliedError on the clamped read-back
review: 2026-10-16: retested: limit 0.6 with load 50 gives 0.3 Vpp; the limit unit (hiz volts) is a design choice. original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md

title: IQ Q angle: range +-10 deg, clamps silently, scales I
fact: IQADjustment:QSKew 45 reads back 10, no error. At 10 deg (baseband QPSK): I rms x 0.9849 (cos 10 deg = 0.9848), I-Q correlation unchanged (-0.006 -> -0.005); IF 1 MHz: CH1-CH2 carrier phase unchanged (89 deg). Gain and offsets also clamp without an error.
consequence: A large angle request silently gives 10 deg; the angle does not rotate Q into I as a quadrature skew would.
where: IQ._adjust read-back raises NotAppliedError; IQ.set_adjust_angle_q docstring
review: 2026-10-16: retested: QSKew 45 reads back 10, no error (silent clamp, as SDG-01). original repository measurements/2026-10-16_07-58-20_review_quirks_awg.md
